overall_findings: 60/60 completed; all transport schemas validated; no local text fallback.

Both answerable Support cases escalated unnecessarily for missing citations; one retained a wrong refund answer.
Some source digests and creative copy still contain unsupported claims; model self-review missed creative issues.
The prior budget-as-unit-price and clipped-word summary defects were not seen in these final-profile fixtures.
